Encodes operation postfix and tag segment from source tag evidence; full SID hash/dehash remains bounded by producer evidence and future child-map work.
POSTFIX_TAG, POSTFIX_GEN, POSTFIX_MOD, and POSTFIX_DUPLICATE are documented beside the helper; broader ;:R/child key evidence remains S5.
Shared alias writers now fill NamedShape mapped_name_provenance through the S2 codec when source/current/type/tag/op evidence exists; incomplete entries remain missing/blocker.
Generated/modified relation classification remains separate from raw-name byte encoding; mapperHistoryIds are not marked supported by C13-M3 S5.
S2 helper canonicalization matches the comparator boundary for :H... and ;D... normalization; comparator remains test/oracle schema only, not runtime source.

FreeCAD passes TopoShape Tag values into encodeElementName as producer evidence. cad-core has no persistent TopoShape identity, so S4 uses a stable topology/geometry fingerprint instead of process-local std::hash<TopoDS_Shape> for request-local tag evidence.
